question: A total profit of ₹14,200 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A: B = 13 : 9 and B : C = 18 : 11. The share (in) of C in the profit is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A : B = 13 : 9, B : C = 18 : 11

Equalize B ⇒ LCM(9,18) = 18

⇒ A : B = 26 : 18

⇒ B : C = 18 : 11

⇒ A : B : C = 26 : 18 : 11

Total parts = 55

C’s share = (11/55) × 14200 = 2840

**∴ Answer = ₹2840**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 13 : 9; B : C = 18 : 11; Total = 14200

**Formula used:**

Combine ratios by equalizing common term

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 13 : 9 ⇒ multiply by 2 ⇒ 26 : 18

⇒ B : C = 18 : 11

⇒ A : B : C = 26 : 18 : 11

⇒ Total parts = 26 + 18 + 11 = 55

⇒ C’s share = (11/55) × 14200

⇒ = 2840

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2840.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

Equalize common term before merging ratios

LCM Method

Use LCM to match middle term

Profit Sharing

Share ∝ ratio parts
